description:
In this Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake guide, we show you how to find all 36 Pieces of Heart scattered throughout Hyrule. From hidden treasures in Lon Lon Ranch and Kakariko Village to challenging minigames, secret caves, Magic Bean locations, and rewards for completing sidequests, we'll walk you through every Heart Piece in the game in the most efficient order.
 
Collecting all 36 Heart Pieces will earn you nine additional Heart Containers, allowing you to reach the maximum of 20 hearts. Whether you're looking to make Link stronger for the challenges ahead or simply want to complete everything Ocarina of Time has to offer, this guide has you covered!

author: IGN
description:
When it comes to strong ambassadors for pop culture, it’s hard to think of anyone more well-rounded than Rahul Kohli. After getting a foothold in the nerd world with iZombie on the CW, Kohli’s career took off after being cast in back-to-back Mike Flanagan projects: The Haunting of Bly Manor and Midnight Mass. Kohli joins IGN’s Tom Jorgensen to play three of the games that mean the most to him - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Doom, and Red Dead Redemption - as well as two games he’s recently starred in: Saros and Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2. Kohli also teases conversations he’s had with his Bly Manor co-star Benjamin Evan Ainsworth about playing Link in live action, how he reacted to IGN handing out a 7 to Saros, and what it was like starring as a deeply disturbing character in Flanagan’s recent adaptation of Carrie.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Rahul Kohli Pulls The Master Sword While Playing His Favorite Video Games | IGN Arcade

author: IGN
description:
GTA 5 Took On Zuckerberg in one of its best, most satirical missions, but the real target was Michael and interactivity.

Friend Request is an early storyline mission in Grand Theft Auto 5. Tutorials are behind us, but Trevor hasn't joined the team yet. Retired crook Michael De Santa is in deep trouble, so he turns to his old accomplice Lester for help. The software enthusiast seems willing to set up a new job, but first he needs Michael to blow open the walled garden that is Jay Norris’s skull. 
GTA’s legendary, long campaigns demand frequent changes of pace, and cooldown character studies like Friend Request offer a different kind of exploration than open-world adventure. 

Trekking through trauma, wandering through wounded pride, we’re given space to dig beneath the skin of the people we embody and understand what drives them. This is the art of the level for Grand Theft Auto 5.

#ign #gta5
title: When GTA 5 Took On Zuckerberg and Won - Art of the Level

author: IGN
description:
Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown DLC reviewed by Travis Northup on PC and Xbox Series X, also available on PlayStation 5.

"Crimson Desert’s Charting the Unknown DLC is unlikely to win over anyone who hadn’t already fallen in love with this massive world, but it does successfully expand a game that already had a staggering amount of stuff to do. Diving around underwater ruins and exploring islands for treasure is a good time, even if the ship exploration and combat on the way to that seafaring content is a bore. Elsewhere, some of the new activities like a business management minigame and NPC dating are absolutely worth adding to your backlog of quests to tackle. Those side distractions continue to be the true appeal of Crimson Desert, but it’s a shame that the new story questlines that act as an extended epilogue are largely as dull as they are inaccessible. Overall, Charting the Unknown is just more Crimson Desert, with its “jack of all trades, master of none” philosophy fully
title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown Review
